Evan M.: HyperCloud reached out about APAC-EAST2 availability on our marketplace. They want an initial reserved pool (6xA40) + KMS customer keys. Can we map out next steps?
Priya S.: tagging @Marco @Lena. We need: quota request, entitlement gating, legal for cross-region KM integration, and a marketing plan.
Marco H.: I'll kick off quota request. Suggest we ask for 6xA40 but allow burst to 12x for launch week. Anyone have cost/budget for burst?
Lena (HyperCloud): We can cover burst at partner-promotional rates. We'll share image manifest and pointer to our key policy. Need to know accepted KMS providers and any network restrictions.
Tom R.: infra-bot will create a provisioning ticket. For KMS: we support AWS KMS and GCP KMS; we require an IAM role that can encrypt/decrypt and a minimal set of actions. We'll send policy snippet.
infra-bot: Ticket created: Q-2026-4721 for apac-east2 capacity request (assigned to @Marco H.). https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/Q-2026-4721
Marco H.: Created PRD with payload:
```
project: partner-marketplace
region: apac-east2
requested_skus: A40-48GB x6 (burst to x12)
purpose: HyperCloud marketplace reserved pool
```
Priya S.: legal-bot, can you confirm if the partner-managed KMS flow requires a DPA amendment for cross-border key handling?
legal-bot: Automated note: DPA amendment required when customer-managed keys are referenced for marketplace entitlements. Manual review assigned to @Evan M.
Evan M.: I'll handle DPA follow-up with HyperCloud. Priya, please draft the entitlement doc for marketplace ops and include key rotation expectations (90-day max rotation preferred).
Lena (HyperCloud): We prefer 180-day rotation but can align to 90 for marketplace customers. Also want to confirm logs/telemetry limitations for customer privacy.
Tom R.: we'll limit telemetry to connection metrics and error traces; no plaintext user data. Send the expected telemetry spec and we'll approve.
Priya S.: marketing ask: partner announcement? If yes, need assets 10 business days before GA. Recommend pilot with 3 customers first.
Marco H.: timeline estimate: quota approval ~2-4 biz days, provisioning 4-6 biz days, partner validation 5 biz days. Total ~2-3 weeks post-approval.
Lena (HyperCloud): OK — we'll prepare pilot customers and consent forms. Providing test keys by next Wed.
Evan M.: owners: infra=@Marco H., partner=@Priya S., legal=@Evan M., eng=@Tom R. Please log blockers in Q-2026-4721.
Priya S.: I'll schedule a kickoff sync with HyperCloud for Monday. Thanks all. :white_check_mark:
